text: Shaping the future of Commerce Getnet integrates payment experiences that unlock efficiency, control an new opportunities for growth. We combine the agility of a fintech with the strength of Santander —one of the world’s leading financial institutions We offer a robust, omnichannel platform that integrates seamlessly with existing ecosystems while delivering powerful proprietary capabilities tailored to our customers’ needs.

title: About us
text: Powering smarter commerce worldwide Getnet supports merchants, ISVs, PayFacs, orchestrators, platforms and the next generation of commerce enablers. We connect technologies and markets through a unified omnichannel payment experience that boosts performance and drives growth. Our comprehensive suite of services includes payment gateway, in-store and e-commerce acquiring, processing, fraud prevention, financial services and value-added solutions tailored to industries such as retail, food & beverage, health & beauty, hospitality, and travel.
